body:
In article <199908140159.DAA01892@relay.globe.cz>, agent99@post.cz writes:

>My dear, your committment to free speech is inspiring.  
>I don't think the Czech courts will honor their request, 
>however.

I'm not sure how you arrived at the conclusion that I am against free speech.
If you stand behind what you have written, why would you be concerned if the
authorities got hold of it?

>Well, he turned himself in and voluntarily confessed.  
>Why would he lie?

He lied for the same reason he turned himself in. He knew that he would be
caught, and that things might go better for him if he turned himself in. His
statement is nonsense. He would make an excuse to avoid the death penalty. 
Like yourself, he is a symptom of the ills of the technological society. In
that context only are you and he interesting.

<pointless, patronizing comment snipped>

>You actually read that tripe?

Jumangi's reasoning is very welcome here. 

-Susan

Paragraph 176, "... They would seek other, dangerous outlets (drugs, crime,
"cults," hate groups)..."
TK on the consequences of the industrial technological society.
